# SYNTHETIC: legacy Apple Silicon charge controller (CH0B and CH0C present, CHTE absent).
# Derived from the real smc_macos27.txt capture with CH0B/CH0C added. Not a real capture.
CHTE	  CHTE  [    ]  no data
CH0B	  CH0B  [ui8 ]  0 (bytes 00)
CH0C	  CH0C  [ui8 ]  0 (bytes 00)
CH0I	  CH0I  [    ]  no data
CH0J	Error: SMCReadKey() = e00002c1
CHIE	  CHIE  [hex_]  (bytes 00)
ACLC	  ACLC  [ui8 ]  3 (bytes 03)
